\begin{example} \end{example}[Nonnegative zeroth-order coefficient] ↗ thm:energy-estimates ↗ thm:poincare-w01p-subcritical 1. ch6:6.2-ex-1\group Weak Solutions

For $Lu=-\Delta u$, the energy estimate holds with $\gamma =0$ by Poincare inequality. The same is true for $Lu=-\sum _{i,j}(a^{ij}u_{x_i})_{x_j}+cu$ when $c\ge 0$. \end{example}
